# llm-judge

> LLM-as-judge with versioned rubrics, strict per-criterion score parsing with one bounded re-ask, and quadratic weighted kappa calibration. Python package `trysac-llm-judge`, import name `llm_judge`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API and limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and judge and calibration flows
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run checks and the acceptance behaviours
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, defended and not defended
